codechat.title: Code
codechat.emptyText: Pick the repositories and say what you want done. agnts works on it as a ticket: follow it here, answer its questions, ask for changes and approve the pull request.
codechat.viewersOnly: Code mode is for people who can change the workspace.
codechat.reposNone: Pick the repositories to work in, or name them in the message with @
codechat.reposSaved: Repositories changed: the next ticket works in them
codechat.quickHint: Build, lint and tests don't run, so review comes sooner.
codechat.ticketPick: Or work on an existing ticket
codechat.placeholderReview: Ask for changes, or approve above…
codechat.placeholderRunning: Add to the request: it is sent when this run ends…
codechat.placeholderStopped: Say how to get past this, and it retries…
codechat.sendHint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter makes a new line, @ names a repository
codechat.queuedTitle: {n, plural, one {# message waits} other {# messages wait}} for this run to end
codechat.sendNowText: The running stage stops, and your messages go to it at once.
codechat.filesChanged: {n, plural, one {# file changed} other {# files changed}}
codechat.approvePr: agnts pushes {branch} and opens a pull request.
codechat.approveMain: agnts pushes the change straight to the default branch.
codechat.approveReport: The ticket closes with this report.
codechat.rejectText: All work on it stops. You can continue it from this chat later.
codechat.stoppedHint: Write how to get past it: it retries with your note.
codechat.doneHint: Your next message starts a new ticket in the same repositories.
codechat.rejectedHint: Write what to do differently and it continues.
codechat.movedHint: {key} moved to another of your conversations.
codechat.approvalTitle: The agent asks to run this
